observations.content: The Rust test build completed with 208 warnings, primarily dead-code/unused items across cli.rs and frontier, pool, service, store, verifier, and related modules.
Frontier lifecycle tests ran 10 cases: 9 passed, including durable lifecycle, drift/corruption rejection, recovery, quota pause/resume, and tampered progress protections.

Test failed: `service::frontier_lifecycle::failed_attempt_charges_the_reservation_and_resume_cannot_reuse_it` panicked at `src/service.rs:8344:1` because `unwrap()` received `InvalidConfiguration("frontier lifecycle: owner spending authority is below the guarded maximum")`; cargo exited with code 101.
